predictions.rationale: Defines the core Critic abstraction that represents a design critic agent.
Manages the collection and execution of critics in background threads.
Implements the control mechanism that schedules critics to run on design changes.
Initializes and starts the critic subsystem when the application launches.
Represents the 'designer' context against which critics reason.
Encapsulates a single design issue reported by a critic.
Maintains the list of ToDoItems generated by critics.
Supports combining multiple critics for more complex analysis.
Provides UI action to open the critics browser, directly related to critic feature exposure.
UI dialog that displays critics and their suggestions to the user.
